summary: Curaleaf Holdings filed a Form 6-K on May 6, 2026, containing its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, and management's discussion and analysis. This is a routine periodic financial reporting filing by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a US quarterly report on Form 10-Q. No mention is made of any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, strategic review, activist campaign, or other special situation. The filing is solely to provide updated financial performance and condition to the market.
